tool-primary.position: after the primary CTA section on tool pages

buyer-intent-top.position: immediately after the opening section on Best / buyer-intent pages

compare-decision-premium.position: immediately before the final decision / verdict area on comparison pages

measurement.conversion_policy: Do not infer advertiser signups, paid customers, sales or revenue from COSHUMA-side impressions or clicks. Vendor-side conversion evidence remains separate.

rules: Applications do not reserve a placement or activate an advertisement.
Only an explicitly allowed page with a server-verified live payment, approved copy, an available slot and a valid start/end period may display an advertisement.
The campaign period begins when the placement is actually activated, not when an inquiry or payment is received.
Campaigns must include startAt and endAt when activated; invalid or missing dates must remain hidden and rendering stops at endAt.
Extensions require a new approved campaign period rather than silently running past the contracted end date.
Paid placement may buy visibility in a labeled sponsored area but must not change independent editorial ratings or organic rankings.
All public sponsored placements must be labeled Sponsored.
Tracked impressions and outbound clicks are measurement signals, not guarantees of leads, signups, sales or revenue.
Homepage, Gamma, Chatbase and the active Privy versus Omnisend comparison experiment are excluded. Wildcard placement targets are not permitted.
